title: Bar Shelamya the scribe
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Berakhot, chapter 4, halakhah 1, with the supplied additional locator 28b, and Taanit, chapter 4, halakhah 1. He asked Rabbi Mana, who replied, “Is this a scribe’s question?”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The phrase asks whether this is a question befitting a scribe; it is not asking about the identity of a scribe.

The consulted whole Guggenheimer paragraphs in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1 and Taanit 4:1 have Bar Shelamya the scribe ask Rabbi Mana and receive the response about a scribe’s question. The full title and direction of the exchange are supported locally. The supplied 28b is retained as Hyman’s additional locator, without claiming a new printed-page collation or importing the legal question’s contents.
